title: Single hieratic sign, Brooklyn (NY), The Brooklyn Museum, 47.218.84 (AKU HT 54032)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Dimitri Meeks; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 54032

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 54032; AKU grapheme G0420 (AKU GR 265). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: G17 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 196, 196 (v4p12), 196B. Source publication of this facsimile: Meeks 2006. Occurrence: line 8; find place Heliopolis; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 11.4 x 9.8 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Spätzeit, 26. Dynastie, Psammetich I.". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Dimitri Meeks. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
